digest.component_or_area: CLI help system generation and serving
propositions: Generated help artifacts must be deterministic, parser-derived, and regenerated from canonical factory grammar rather than hand-maintained text
Top-level help routes must complete lexical pre-scan before operation composition, config parsing, store mounting, or handler resolution
Canonical visible commands appear once in grouped overview; exact aliases reuse bytes; compatibility and hidden spellings render with approved alias prog and replacement epilog
Help artifact bodies are regenerated from factory parsers with enriched per-argument help= and description/epilog text; only the capitalized 'Usage:' prefix is byte-preserved
Generator --check mode must fail on missing/stale/stray artifacts, blank summaries, non-deterministic renders, or registry/parser census mismatch
All 21 formerly intercept-only help forms now succeed safely with approved behavior changes to overview grouping and output determinism
